description: Generate CRM acquisition insights for the GaaS Jornada & Disparos Insight Deck. Runs a deterministic Python evidence collector against Supabase (weighted views + activities), then writes analyst-grade insights in PT-BR following the Dossie Mestre narrative (Sinal, Impacto, Causa, Evidencia, Acao, Confianca) and publishes them to the crm_insights table. Use when the user asks to run the insight engine, gerar insights, atualizar o insight deck, rodar analise de gargalos/portfolio CRM, or on a scheduled insight routine.
